## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behaviour/material. Reference the local PD/requirement ID when applicable; YouTrack is excluded by the owner.

## Verification

Record exact checks and their results, including failures, skipped integration tests and limits.

## Review and evidence

Request an actual independent team review before merge. Identify changed requirements, diagrams and user scenarios. Do not invent feedback, measurements, contribution dates or approvals. Keep real credentials and customer data out of the diff.
